effects.effect:
You have an epic resource called order. Each time you finish a [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite), you gain order equal to the [XP](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/experience) you gain. You can spend order on your abilities as if it were discipline.

At the start of a combat encounter, you can spend 1 order to increase the size of your [Null Field](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.null.level-1/null-field) by 1 until the end of the encounter.

Order remains until you spend it.
